FAQ

Common questions

Do customers need to download an app?

No. Any modern iPhone or Android phone can read the card just by tapping it — no app, login, or account required.

How long does a card last?

Our cards are made from durable PVC with an embedded NFC chip rated for tens of thousands of taps, so they hold up well to daily use for years.

Can I change where the card links to later?

Yes. Reach out to us and we can reprogram your card's destination link at any time, at no extra cost.

What if a card stops working?

Simply reach out to us and we’ll take care of it with a free repair or replacement.
